# Obama Conspiracy Theories

> A comprehensive debunking archive examining and refuting conspiracy theories about Barack Obama's birth certificate, citizenship, and eligibility, spanning December 2008 through January 2017.

Run by Dr. Conspiracy (Kevin Davidson), this site provides fact-checked analysis of birther movement claims, Cold Case Posse investigations, and eligibility challenges through technical analysis, legal case documentation, and evidence-based debunking. The blog concluded in January 2017 with extensive archives and resource collections for researchers and fact-checkers.

## Key Topics

- Barack Obama
- Birth certificate
- Birther movement
- Cold Case Posse
- Obama eligibility
- Conspiracy theories
- Fact-checking and debunking
- Kenya birthplace claims
- Hawaii birth records

- Citizenship claims
- Political conspiracy
- Mike Zullo

- 2016 presidential campaign

## Core Debunking Resources

- [The Debunker's Guide to Obama Conspiracy Theories](https://www.obamaconspiracy.org/debunk): Comprehensive guide debunking Obama birth certificate, birthplace, and citizenship claims with evidence-based analysis
- [The Debunker's Guide to Obama Conspiracy Theories (Bookmarks)](https://www.obamaconspiracy.org/bookmarks/fact-checking-and-debunking/the-debunkers-guide-to-obama-conspiracy-theories): Comprehensive guide debunking Obama birth certificate and eligibility claims
- [Resources](https://www.obamaconspiracy.org/resources): Research collection of debunking resources, legal cases, and document archives
- [Bookmarks](https://www.obamaconspiracy.org/bookmarks): Curated resource directory of Obama conspiracy fact-checking and debunking links

## Technical Analysis & Evidence

- [The mathematics of date stamp angle similarities–Part 1](https://www.obamaconspiracy.org/2017/01/the-mathematics-of-date-stamp-angle-similarities-part-1): Statistical debunking of birther claims about birth certificate date stamps
- [The mathematics of date stamp angle similarities–Part 2](https://www.obamaconspiracy.org/2017/01/the-mathematics-of-date-stamp-angle-similarities-part-2): Technical analysis debunking date stamp angle similarity conspiracy claims

## Cold Case Posse Investigation

- [Cold Case Posse disbanded](https://www.obamaconspiracy.org/2017/01/cold-case-posse-disbanded): Post on Cold Case Posse disbanding under new Maricopa County Sheriff
- [Cold Case Posse referred to IRS for failure to file Form 990](https://www.obamaconspiracy.org/2013/08/cold-case-posse-referred-to-irs-for-failure-to-file-form-990): Article on Cold Case Posse IRS compliance violations and tax-exempt status
- [Cold Case Posse web site down early this year](https://www.obamaconspiracy.org/2016/11/cold-case-posse-web-site-down-early-this-year): Post analyzing Cold Case Posse website outage and domain expiration issues
